name: 1 Pair Magnet Toe Corrector Silicone Foot Protector
description:
1 Pair Magnet Toe Corrector Silicone Foot Protector 

Material: Silicone 
Size: Free Size 
Color: Skin color 
High-quality material: Made of durable and safe-grade silicone gel, stretching your toes and covering bunion with its flexible touch. 
All day comfort and protection:These hammer toe straighteners are ergonomically designed and made of very soft silicone gel. Let us know how to straighten toes in comfort. 
Sport Friendly: This toe hair straightener can be used at home while walking and practicing yoga. 
Reusable: Wash with soap and air dry then you can use it again and again..
